newsitem.title: USA: Vanguard Airlines Feb. load factor rises.
newsitem.headline: Vanguard Airlines Feb. load factor rises.

text.p: Vanguard Airlines Inc said Wednesday its passenger load factor in February rose 3.02 points to 57.97 percent from 54.95 percent.
Revenue passenger miles increased 72.3 percent to 68.1 million from 39.5 million, and available seat miles grew 63.3 percent to 117.4 million from 71.9 million.

Year to date, the carrier said its load factor rose 6.50 points to 54.74 percent from 48.24 percent. Revenue passenger miles jumped 98.8 percent to 135.3 million from 68.0 million, and available seat miles rose 75.2 percent to 247.1 million from 141.0 million.
